The full chain: - **All three call sites** (`index`, `refresh`, shadow-branch sweep, and the backfill path) now pass `parsed.tokens_used` to `upsert_session` - **On conflict**, the DB takes `MAX(existing, new)` — so later checkpoints with more turns always win, and a full re-index will correctly accumulate the highest count - `checkpoint` → `full.jsonl` → parser sums `output_tokens` from every assistant turn → stored in DB → shown in TUI Running `gossamer index` now will backfill token counts for all existing sessions.
